exposure: Socioeconomic status: Quintiles of Index of Multiple Deprivation
cohort: Patients referred to the Royal National Orthopaedic Hospital with BRBPI in 2004 (N=67), 2014 (N=61), and 2017 (N=71)
finding: Black and Asian patients had a significantly higher risk of BRBPI compared to White patients, and a trend towards greater risk was observed for patients from lower socioeconomic groups.
